archers.spell.archers.barrage.description: Fire 3 accurate arrows, spaced 0.15 seconds apart. Each deals 60%% of normal shot damage.
archers.spell.archers.magic_arrow.description: Fire 4 seeking arrows, spaced 0.25 seconds apart. Each deals up to 80%% ranged damage at full charge. Partial charges deal less damage. Arrows seek the nearest enemy within 32 blocks, pass through walls and last 10 seconds. Upgrades improve damage or tracking.

wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_barrage.description: Summon 3 Arcane Emitters that fire at your target or where you aim. Each lasts 6 seconds. Bolts deal 40%% of the emitter's own Arcane power; emitter power grows with your Arcane power.
wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_beam.description: Channel 25 hits over 5 seconds, each dealing 20%% Arcane damage before upgrades. Base cooldown rises from 15 to 30 seconds with channel completion, reduced by haste. Consumes all Arcane Charges. Charged Beam changes the channel and damage.
wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_blast.description: Blast the target for 80%% Arcane damage and gain an Arcane Charge, up to 3 stacks before upgrades.
wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_blink.description: Blink forward up to 10 blocks before upgrades. Deal 50%% Arcane damage within 5 blocks at departure immediately and at arrival after 0.25 seconds.
wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_evocation.descripti: Channel to gain up to 10 Evocation stacks lasting 10 seconds before upgrades. Each stack grants 5%% base spell critical chance and 3%% base spell haste, but increases damage taken by 10%%.
wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_explosion.descripti: Create an explosion centered on the targeted enemy, dealing 260%% Arcane damage within 7 blocks before upgrades. Echoing Blast lowers the damage and resets the cooldown on a hit.
wizards.spell.wizards.arcane_missile.description: Channel 12 homing missiles over 4 seconds, each dealing 26%% Arcane damage before upgrades. Range: 32 blocks. Base cooldown rises from 8 to 16 seconds with channel completion, reduced by haste.
wizards.spell.wizards.fire_blast.description: Launch an explosive fireball, dealing up to 100%% Fire damage within 2.5 blocks. Splash damage decreases with distance.
wizards.spell.wizards.fire_breath.description: Channel fire in front of you, dealing 13%% Fire damage per hit with no distance falloff. Base cooldown rises from 4 to 8 seconds with channel completion, reduced by haste.
wizards.spell.wizards.fire_meteor.description: After a 2-second cast, drop 3 meteors on the target. Each deals 150%% Fire damage within 6 blocks, with no distance falloff. Base cooldown: 20 seconds, reduced by haste.
wizards.spell.wizards.fire_slash.description: Launch a wide wave of flame after a 0.1-second cast, dealing 100%% Fire damage to enemies in its path.
wizards.spell.wizards.fire_wall.description: Place up to 4 walls within 5 seconds of the first cast. Each wall lasts 8 seconds before upgrades and deals 20%% Fire damage per hit, reaching 2 blocks high. The fourth cast or the end of the placement window starts the 24-second base cooldown.
wizards.spell.wizards.fireball.description: Launch a fireball, dealing 80%% Fire damage and setting the target on fire.
wizards.spell.wizards.frost_blizzard.description: Channel falling frost shards onto the target and nearby enemies. Each impact deals about 26.7%% Frost damage within 3 blocks, with no distance falloff, and slows enemies. Base cooldown rises from 12 to 20 seconds with channel completion, reduced by haste.
wizards.spell.wizards.frost_nova.description: Deal 180%% Frost damage to enemies within 10 blocks and freeze them for 2 seconds before upgrades. Frozen enemies cannot move and are vulnerable to Frost magic.
wizards.spell.wizards.frost_shard.description: Launch a frost shard that can bounce off walls, dealing 60%% Frost damage on impact.
wizards.spell.wizards.frost_shield.description: Become immune to incoming damage for 3 seconds before upgrades. Hits do not consume the shield. Reduces base movement speed by 100%% while active. Natural expiry releases a non-damaging burst within 5 blocks, freezing enemies for 2 seconds.
wizards.spell.wizards.frost_spikes.description: Raise 8 frost spikes along an 8-block row before upgrades. Each hit deals 80%% Frost damage and freezes enemies for 2 seconds. Frozen enemies cannot move and are vulnerable to Frost magic.
wizards.spell.wizards.frostbolt.description: Launch a frost projectile that ricochets to 2 additional nearby targets before upgrades, dealing 80%% Frost damage and slowing enemies on impact.
wizards.spell.wizards.elemental_frost_shard.desc: Deal 100%% of the elemental's own Frost power as damage.

skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass: Casting an Arcane spell grants an absorption shield for 8 seconds: 1 heart, plus 1 heart for every 5 Arcane power. Base cooldown: 16 seconds, reduced by haste.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv: Casting a Fire spell grants an absorption shield for 8 seconds: 1 heart, plus 1 heart for every 10 Fire power. Attackers take 30%% Fire damage. Base cooldown: 16 seconds, reduced by haste.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi: Casting a Frost spell grants an absorption shield for 8 seconds: 1 heart, plus 1 heart for every 10 Frost power. Slows attackers. Base cooldown: 16 seconds, reduced by haste.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi: After rolling, your next Frost spell within 5 seconds deals 20%% more damage. Base cooldown: 10 seconds, reduced by haste.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel: Add 20 falling arrows, for 60 total, spaced 0.35 seconds apart across a random 6-block radius. Each deals 60%% ranged damage with a 2.5-block splash.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel: Arcane Missiles fires 1 additional missile in each batch.
Arcane Missiles slows enemies by 10%% base movement speed per stack, up to 30%% at 3 stacks. Lasts 4 seconds, refreshed by hits.
Arcane Missiles gains 10%% more spell power.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel: Arcane Beam gains 5 percentage points of spell critical chance.

Channel 50 hits over 10 seconds. Damage starts at 10%% Arcane power per hit, increasing by 0.15 percentage points per hit up to 15%%. The beam starts 30%% wider and gains 10%% of its original width per hit, up to 5 times normal width.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel: Reduce Evocation's base cooldown by 5 seconds, from 35 to 30 seconds at full channel.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_: Fire Breath hits have a 10%% chance to trigger an explosion, dealing up to 30%% Fire damage within 2.5 blocks. Damage decreases with distance. Base cooldown: 0.2 seconds, reduced by haste.
Increase Fire Breath range by 4 blocks, from 8 to 12 blocks.
Fire Breath gains 5 percentage points of spell critical chance.
Increase Flame Slash range by 5 blocks.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_: Meteor drops 1 additional meteor, for 4 total.
Meteor impacts create a burning area after 0.25 seconds. It lasts 6 seconds within 5 blocks, reaches 2 blocks high and deals 10%% Fire damage per hit.
Reduce Meteor's base cooldown by 2 seconds, from 20 to 18 seconds.
Firestorm hits 2 additional times and gains 100%% extra base knockback, pushing enemies away.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_: Wall of Flames lasts 2 seconds longer, for 10 seconds total.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell: Frost Nova hits cause secondary explosions, dealing 20%% Frost damage within 3 blocks.
Frost Nova applies 1 additional Frozen stack to each enemy.
Frost Nova freezes enemies for 0.5 seconds longer, for 2.5 seconds total.
Frost Spikes gains 10%% more spell power.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell: Gain 50%% base movement speed for 3 seconds while using Frost Shield, offsetting half of its base movement penalty.
Frost Shield lasts 1 second longer, for 4 seconds total.
Reduce Frost Shield's base cooldown by 3 seconds, from 12 to 9 seconds.
Ice Lance is 50%% larger and gains 15 percentage points of spell critical chance.
Reduce Ice Lance's base cooldown by 2 seconds, from 12 to 10 seconds.
skill_tree_rpgs.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell: Blizzard slows enemies by 20%% base movement speed per stack, up to 60%% at 3 stacks. Lasts 3 seconds, refreshed by hits.
Blizzard hits 3 additional times, for 15 channel hits total.
